title: Detailed sushi roll
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- plate -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='42' ry='14' fill='#3a5a8c'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='69' rx='42' ry='14' fill='#5f8fd0'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='69' rx='33' ry='10' fill='#7fb0ec'/>
  <!-- shadow under roll -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='24' ry='8' fill='#4a6fa5'/>
  <!-- seaweed outer wrap -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='26' ry='20' fill='#221a3a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='26' ry='20' fill='none' stroke='#4a3a78' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- rice layer -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='21' ry='16' fill='#fdf7ee'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='21' ry='16' fill='none' stroke='#e6dccb' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- rice grain dots -->
  <g fill='#e8dfd0'>
    <circle cx='38' cy='50' r='1.4'/>
    <circle cx='44' cy='45' r='1.3'/>
    <circle cx='58' cy='46' r='1.4'/>
    <circle cx='63' cy='53' r='1.2'/>
    <circle cx='36' cy='60' r='1.3'/>
    <circle cx='45' cy='64' r='1.2'/>
    <circle cx='60' cy='63' r='1.3'/>
    <circle cx='66' cy='58' r='1.2'/>
  </g>
  <!-- salmon filling -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='55' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#ff8a5c'/>
  <path d='M39 54 Q46 48 53 54' stroke='#ffb08c' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M40 58 Q46 53 52 58' stroke='#ffb08c' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <!-- avocado filling -->
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='52' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#8fd35a'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='52' rx='2.5' ry='3.5' fill='#c8ec9a'/>
  <!-- cucumber filling -->
  <circle cx='55' cy='60' r='4' fill='#3f9e4d'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='60' r='2.2' fill='#bfe8a8'/>
  <!-- nori stripe accent on top rim -->
  <path d='M30 48 Q50 36 70 48' stroke='#2e2450' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none'/>
  <!-- sesame seeds on rice -->
  <g fill='#f3e6c0'>
    <circle cx='40' cy='48' r='0.9'/>
    <circle cx='52' cy='43' r='0.9'/>
    <circle cx='61' cy='49' r='0.9'/>
    <circle cx='34' cy='56' r='0.9'/>
    <circle cx='47' cy='68' r='0.9'/>
    <circle cx='63' cy='64' r='0.9'/>
  </g>
  <!-- ginger blob -->
  <path d='M76 62 q6 -4 8 2 q2 6 -6 6 q-5 0 -4 -4 q1 -3 2 -4z' fill='#ffd6e0'/>
  <path d='M78 63 q3 -2 4 1' stroke='#ffb3c6' stroke-width='1' fill='none'/>
  <!-- wasabi blob -->
  <path d='M18 60 q5 -5 8 1 q2 5 -4 5 q-5 0 -4 -6z' fill='#a8e060'/>
  <circle cx='21' cy='59' r='1' fill='#d4f5a0'/>
</svg>
